To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
macrophages have a contractile apparatus in the plasmalemma, which can be isolated in the form of podosomes.

we have identified a cell fraction, called podosomes, which is a membrane-bounded sac of contractile proteins and enzymes, and that this fraction is enriched in specific adenyl cyclase activity and is capable of phagocytosis.

we have isolated from macrophage homogemates a fraction consisting of membrane-bound sacs containing contractile proteins and enzymes that are enriched in mysoin, actin-binding protein relative to the homogenates.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the biochemical and functional characterization of the peripheral cell fraction of the macrophage.
the biochemical and functional analysis of a cell organelle, the podosome, and its role in macrophage motility and phagocytosis.
the structure, composition, and function of macrophage podosomes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

we have isolated a cell fraction containing the contractile apparatus, the sensory apparatus, and the motor apparatus of macrophages and that these structures have the potential to respond to environmental cues.
the peripheral blebs are enriched in myofibrils and contractile proteins and that they are capable of responding to environmental signals.
podosomes are contractile structures of the cell periphery that can be isolated from rabbit alveolar macrophages.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the plasmalemma of macrophages can be isolated in a highly purified form, and that the plasmalemma contains contractile proteins, enzymes, and receptors.
the podosome is the contractile apparatus of macrophages.
we have isolated a fraction of macrophage plasma membrane that is rich in contractile proteins and has the ability to respond to environmental stimuli.
The main takeaway from our work is that
podosomes have the capacity to sense the environment and to move in response to environmental cues.
podosomes are not just an interesting morphological feature, but rather they have a functional significance in macrophages.
we have isolated a structure that is enriched in myosim and actin binding protein, indicating that these structures are regulated in the periphery of the cell.
